text:
Alright, so, this is such a good reply -- I'm surprised that no one else asked the same question.

"What if the stress is from family?" -- those are 100% some of the hardest fucking problems u will ever face in life

long post - I will try and break this all down.

"Be the bigger man" - 1/10

1. High-Level Shit

so, before getting into this, we gotta get square on beliefs

we may disagree. that's fine (and prob expected)

u can just recognize, these are the core beliefs that underpin the rest of this post.

It has taken me prob 5 years of heavy reading, trial and error, to get a functional system in place...it works...walk with me, keep an open mind.

if at any point u feel angry, exit

family is a "never argue w people" topic

too unique and we are all too poisoned mentally to be objective.

--

the top 2

some things u don't want to fuck around with, I would say top 2 are God and family

they are linked

blood is blood, loyalty is loyalty

u never turn ur back on family. u never cut anyone off.

there are very rare exceptions - assault, addiction - where they have to crash out/rock bottom...but then, u reappear and catch them.

so its only temporary, even worst case

if u believe in cutting family off, u can exit here - the entire post is predicated on not doing that.

we can politely disagree

but I am not fighting w/ anyone over that key point....thats why its up front

for ur own clarity, ask around, be aware of how the world and the crowd perceive a human that cuts family off

this isnt about me -- block/unfollow me, poof, I'm gone.

its about the 8 billion other people u have to deal with.

overall, the playbook for dealing w toxic people, doesnt work here. u are stuck with them (as they are with you) which is why stress is a major topic

2. Duty

as a man at least there is shit u have to do, whether u want to or not

to not do it, is to go against God

this includes taking care of ur parents and "being the bigger man" when they are totally out of line

forgive the past, they put up with ur shit

but, I'm pretty harsh on this topic w friends, w self, and in "top 2" topics, there is no point in mincing words

like, some parts of life have clearly defined right and wrong -- this is one of them -- so why fuck around.

when ur buddy is wrong u smack the shit out of him

3. Straight Talk

it happens, like guys get pissed at their 80 year old dad and block him out

but man to man, talking to u as I would a friend -- perhaps the ONLY person who is going to shit u straight

no way around it - brotha, u are dead ass fucking wrong, and u are being a petty little bitch-ass

there is shit u have to do, there is duty involved, and to not accept it puts u at the lowest of lows.

when I say God is involved, like, God will find a way to torture u for these decisions down the line, reminding u of times when u were pathetic or were a coward

call your fuckin mom and tell her u love her, today

tell ur dad u love him, ur grateful, whatever

if u have beef, dead it, forgive

fwiw, if reading this post is unpleasant for u, bail

this is the level I am at with friends and with self -- "real friends stab you in the front."

most people don't have one true friend who will slap the shit out of them

"ur fuckin dad is going to die soon, and when he does, God is going to put a burning spear thru ur heart. thats regret. it will be regret for the way u are acting right now, by not being the bigger man."

how do I know, mine died when I was young

and since then I've watched others make the same mistake u are making

u hold the grudge, they die, and u collapse..."what was I thinking"

"what I would give just to have lunch with him one more time...."

these are matters of God, mon frere....I am dead serious for a reason. the stakes are high.

4. Blood Loyalty

and then just in reading others...always ask

if u arent loyal to blood, who are u loyal to?

A: nobody.

I'm no-questions-asked out the door on that

"loyal to no one" is glaring, its reliable, and it can FUCK your life up if u dont understand the ramifications.

a man has never had a knife put into his back by an enemy

an enemy never gets a clean shot at your back -- u keep eyes on that motherfucker

the knife always comes from someone u let get too close.

so if I miss the 1 out of 100 who is a good dude, so be it...the other 99 are snakes or rats.

what is a man without family or loyalty?

just slithering around, using people to their advantage and discarding them when they're inconvenient

what u will learn is very simple

there is only one thing that happens when u hang around with snakes and rats:

u get bit.

many men are "not a friend and not an enemy."

that's what these are. nothings, avoids

pure opinion, but soon as u hear "I have no friends" or u sense "loyal to no one"...or ur gut says strange shit like "why are there no day ones"

there's something there

I get the message God, u only had to smash me with it 10, 15, 20 times.

and when u hear someone say over and over, "I'll die for my family," "x for my family,"

every man believes that, it doesn't need to be said.

when ur gut says: "he's smashing the gong a liiiiiittle too hard."

the depth of that relationship is millimeters, a dry twig

soon as u fart in the wrong direction, ur gonna get stabbed, with a "for my family bro"

slit ur throat for a nickel, "for my kids bro"

do a deal with them, what's normally a handshake, is direct to court. "u know how it is bro, I'll die for mine, its just biz, family first"

its not 100% wrong, sometimes its genuine -- its that most men have family AND friends

this is not an either/or

when its presented as such, listen to what is unsaid:

"if you put your faith in me, or invest too much into this relationship, you are going to learn a very painful lesson."

friendship is just not a thing for a lot of people

and they're telling u the deal. 

scorpion, frog, etc...they're not wrong, ur wrong for not listenening.

5. Nothing Is Special

people all have their "no I'm special" grudges and resentment

I'm not gonna convince u otherwise

ur situation isn't special...if u sent it out to Twitter, u would get laughed at for how juvenile it sounds (again, w/ very rare exceptions being violence, sexual assault, etc)

if ur gut says Twitter would dunk on u, listen to ur gut...means ur not being the bigger man.

u are just wallowing in petty shit...tom fuckin petty over there

"my 80-something year old dad said xyz and it pissed me off"

dude he's fucking 80

be the bigger man

how much shit did he go thru for you when u were a kid? guarantee it was worse than this

the stress is real, to answer the QT

I will get into exit strategies towards the end

for now, forgive forgive forgive

thats the counter for almost everything

example: "my dad was a piece of shit/bad father so I don't forgive him."

well....going through life without forgiving people and carrying vengeance, open sores, resentment, and being just a big angry pile of fire

your life is going to absolutely suck ass, you will never know peace

all part of the divine design

twtr has two camps, people trying to be helpful and upbeat, and then the people who are broken and toxic and pissed at the world...just lashing the fuck out at people, victim mentality

u are giving off camp 2 vibes

I can recognize instantly which camp someone is in...1, build, 2, block.

cars go 0 to 60, u want a "0 to block" time of two, three seconds

each second beyond that is an L. they win by wasting ur time

on camp 2, "never make the same mistake twice" has saved my bacon...but this one, I made the same mistake repeatedly

thinking that all men want to change, improve, climb, grow, build, succeed

they dont.

u can tell a man "here is exactly how to fix ur life" and they'll actively say, u know what, I'd rather stay down here than climb up there...they get more joy out of attacking people than their own success.

two men see ackman/pershing square
1st guy: "I'm gonna try and build that, so I can rise to his level."
2nd guy: "I'm gonna spend 50 years attacking him, so I can bring him down to my level."

that's how it is. scroll a guy's feed, u see immediately if he's 1 or 2....oil and water, ghibellines and guelphs.

cut, block, run

keep it moving.

6. Serve God

now..if u really hold urself out to be someone who seeks to know God, and imitate his ways

then u already know, u are not walking the walk.

at the heart of imitating God, is forgiveness, grace, kindness, mercy, love for family, and love for fellow man

emphasis: infinite forgiveness and infinite patience for family.

this is very important because I am going to just blast all excuses with that list

those are a pretty universal list of values, if your values don't align with those ("unforgiving, fuck people, fuck mercy"), like...I wish u the best but this post isnt going to help

get that hate out of ur heart.

again, if u arent on board with the "high-level" stuff so far (family, God) hit ESC

this is God territory in the sense that, family relationships hit emotions/feelings in a unique way

and when u go against this kind of shit, God finds a way to torture you internally...like betrayal of family/blood, idk if any deeper layers of hell exist

alright, lets do the tactics

7. Final Fantasy Tactics

ball knower video game

family situations suck ass.

family is aggravating, they cross the line and will say shit that is hurtful. happens to everyone.

you sit there, you suck it up, and u learn what it means to "set boundaries."

u dont cut people off, u let them know -- the line is here... if they dont respect it, the convo ends and u walk out

"when u are ready to be civil, come get me."

repeat until they respect your ground rules (which are mostly just basic respect)

"how do I deal with family stress?"

u just deal with it, because u put up with their shit, and someday, theyre gonna put up with ur shit.

family is all u got.

but u can minimize stress thru understanding boundaries -- if someone is being real fucking toxic or manipulative, there is the "stone face" response

"thanks for your feedback"

"thanks"

"I appreciate it and I'll keep that in mind"

not snarky, not sarcastic -- just, stone wall...this isnt a convo.

find something genuine that u would say. if its not genuine, u are escalating

passive aggressive/manipulator types thrive on this snarky/sarcastic back and forth

they're looking for u to take a subtle dig so they can ratchet the drama higher

u wanna make it clear...I am putting the fire out.

there's a lot of guys like this on twitter, just spending hours a day slipping subtle jabs, subtweets, passive aggressive remarks. extremely feminine

one woman in ur life is enough

u dont need men that act like women, trying to drag u into a cat fight

in life, its easier to cut/block/run

with family, the stone wall is u saying "not here - do that shit to someone else... u got the wrong guy."

once they see they can't get under ur skin, they move on

8. stress minimization

this is understanding how to put physical/emotional space between u and someone who is stressing u the hell out

and I'll assume its emotional stress, some stress is always normal...we're talking, u feel they're wrong-type stress.

u protect ur energy, u protect ur mental -- u have a life to live...if they are fucking with ur head, to where u cant work, cant sleep, cant function, thats really on you

because people are gonna do what they do. u cannot change that.

all u can change is how u react + ur coping mechanisms + self-respect + willingness to immediately pull up the castle gate bridge, like on a dime

"no, sorry, we aint doing that" - boom.

9. what do you believe?

if u dont have basic principles, this world will walk all over u...I didn't get this until my mid 30's

they are rules u keep with the man in the mirror, and no one, literally no one, crosses them.

if u are consistent, and u treat everyone the same, and always react the same to the same behavior...people WILL get in line.

if u bend, ur rules/principles are all worthless.

the go-to for dealing with stress, the mantra:

"BE THE BIGGER MAN."

breathe

u are right, they are wrong, happens a lot w/ family...emotions run hot.

but someone has to be the bigger man.

smile. say "thank you." 

look for the nearest exit

u can shake it off in private, just be the bigger man, quietly acknowledge "they're wrong and I just need to survive this interaction with my dignity intact."

it doesn't cure the stress, u will feel those barbs...but it will help re-align ur mindset/attitude and remind u who u want to be

stoic, basically

it hits u, u feel it, but u are able to quickly blunt the mental/emotional damage thru having a powerful mind, stocked with weapons and armor

and where u have cat-like reflexes in dealing with behavior or comments that are 100% wrong/toxic...just, "no"

10. mindset

ur gut instinct is literally the most accurate thing on earth in dealing with people. it understands concepts that we dont have words for.

I've been trading markets long enough where I have a pretty advanced relationship with it, but I wasn't sure if it applies better for life or for markets

its better for life. its human.

it feels the energy that people fill or drain from u.

the positive ppl are no brainers

if its neutral, bad, or even "good but sketchy"... trust your fucking gut instinct, my man

"why does this dude follow every girl I've ever slept with on social media, within minutes of meeting her"

heres the question u should really be asking

if u went to jail for a month and asked him "keep an eye on my girl, would ya"

what do u think would happen?

ur gut is telling u...u might just be stupid enough to want to find out the hard way.

"wow, I can't believe that snakes bite people. all the music/books/moves/tweets that said this would happen...it actually happened."

"I can't believe the guy that tries to fuck all my ex-girlfriends, wasn't a loyal dude"

brilliant insights dude... I hope u dont use that brain to cross the street

(in fairness, I said all these things at one point, which is why this post feels too close to home at times -- all learned the hard way)

no one ever says "hi, I'm a snake" or "a rat" or "hi, I'm a fake friend!"

you hear about them constantly though

most people learn what a rat is, they have a friend who was doing dirt, he got caught, and to get a reduced sentence...says u were the kingpin, and testifies against u.

the first glimpse is your best friend, on the stand, trying to get you 120 months so he can get probation instead of 5

thats just one of many scenarios but it illustrates the same point

"its never ur enemies that get u, its always ur own people"

END

at a younger age this isnt intuitive, and its why family will inflict deep wounds on u... u dont understand yet that theres a balance

u sit there and let them fuck you up and ruin your entire day, for no reason other than misguided loyalty

it doesnt work like that...u cant change them, but u can make it clear, repeatedly - "every time u say X, I am outta here."

they may change, they may not, but this is how u thread the needle between loyalty + protecting your own headspace...theoretically, u can be loyal while also telling someone to go fuck themselves.

as long as the unconditional blood loyalty is there, like, have it out...establish territory...its almost a given that ur nastiest blowups are gonna be with family, bc u cannot cut them out.

man, I could've written a post 5x as long....I'll see what engagement says, if its there, I'll do another.

all those years paying for expensive therapists, this is the shit u learn.

God bless, protect ur mental king 😎
